content: The G-BERT model takes medical codes' ontology embeddings as input, and obtains intermediate representations from a Transformer encoder as the visit embeddings. It is then pre-trained on EHR from patients who only have one hospital visit. The derived encoder and visit embedding will be fed into a classifier and fine-tuned to make predictions.
